readout_other: Disease activity index, stool consistency, gross bleeding; colon length; H&E histology score; cytokine array
direction_notes: FUS to the celiac plexus improved stool consistency and bleeding scores, preserved colon length and normalised cytokine levels in DSS rats; neural activity was not measured.

exposures.label: FUS to celiac plexus, once or twice daily

timing.protocol_description: 3 min of FUS once or twice daily (twice daily sessions about 6 h apart) for 12 days, bursts of 300 carrier cycles (first 120 us ON, 199.88 ms OFF) repeated at 5 Hz, drive amplitude 300 mV peak-to-peak from the function generator. Mock FUS used the same procedure with the equipment turned off.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Once or twice daily, 3 min of FUS was applied to the target area with a carrier frequency of 2.5 MHz
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Once or twice daily, 3 min of FUS was applied to the target area with a carrier frequency of 2.5 MHz
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: Ultrasound was delivered as bursts repeated at 5 Hz with each burst comprising 300 carrier cycles.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: each burst was repeated at 200 ms intervals within which the first 120 μs was ON
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: a custom made 2.5 MHz, FUS transducer
source_quotes.sham_type: the RF power amplifier, function generator and transducer were turned off
source_quotes.blinding: while the histopathological tissue was scored by three blinded lab personnel
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Similar improvements were seen in animals in the low dose DSS group, who received FUS only once daily for 12 days.
